title: $500 A Month: The Last 10 Years Add $1 Million

beats.say: Put in five hundred dollars a month for forty years, and the last ten years alone add about one million dollars.
beats.visual: a tall glowing tower of gold coins rising into a dark sky above a small stack, dramatic low angle, no people

beats.say: This is an illustration, not a promise. We assume eight percent a year, and no market pays that on schedule.
beats.visual: a hand resting on a worn paper ledger beside a calculator under a green banker lamp, close-up, no faces

beats.say: Here is the math. After ten years, you have put in sixty thousand dollars. It has grown to about ninety one thousand.
beats.visual: a small sapling in a pot on a sunlit windowsill, soft morning light

beats.say: That feels slow. This is where most people quit.
beats.visual: an empty running track at dawn with a single pair of shoes left on the line, wide shot

beats.say: After twenty years, about two hundred ninety four thousand dollars. Still only one hundred twenty thousand of it is yours.
beats.visual: a snowball beginning to roll down a gentle snowy slope, golden hour light

beats.say: After thirty years, about seven hundred forty five thousand.
beats.visual: a large snowball gathering speed down a long slope between pine trees, dramatic light

beats.say: So what do the final ten years do?
beats.visual: a dark cliff edge above a glowing valley at dusk, a single path leading toward it, silhouette

beats.say: After forty years, about one million seven hundred forty five thousand. Only two hundred forty thousand of it is deposits.
beats.visual: a vast wave of glowing gold light rolling across a dark ocean at night, wide shot

beats.say: Here is the part nobody tells you. The final ten years added about one million dollars, from just sixty thousand of new deposits.
beats.visual: a single match lighting a huge bonfire at night in an open field, sparks rising

beats.say: The first twenty years built the base. The last ten harvested it. Quitting at year ten throws that away.
beats.visual: a farmer's silhouette walking into a golden wheat field at sunrise, long shadows

beats.say: The honest catch: real returns bounce around, fees take a cut, and inflation shrinks every dollar. Your numbers will not match this one.
beats.visual: a stormy sea with waves rising and falling under a heavy sky, a lighthouse in the distance

beats.say: But the shape holds. Time does the heavy lifting, so the move is to start and stay in.
beats.visual: a single stone step leading up a long quiet staircase into morning mist, no people

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: an empty highway stretching toward a glowing sunrise horizon, wide shot

caption: At an assumed 8% a year, $500 a month for 40 years grows to about $1.75 million, and the last 10 years add about $1 million. An illustration, not a promise. Educational content, not financial advice.
